research_boundary: Source-checked GitHub issue state and Opire payment terms; operator credentials, payment method, actual fulfillment and award histories not authenticated. Do not claim or develop for payment on this basis.

listings.title: Claude Code destructive-command hook advertised as USD 100 bounty
listings.scope: Python pre-tool-use safety hook detecting rm -rf, SQL deletion and force-push with log messages
listings.payment_limitation: GitHub issue promises automatic payment on merge, whereas Opire payment-provider documentation states that bounty owners review and arrange payment directly; this cannot be treated as an automatic payable contract. 1,886 comments are not 1,886 PRs.
listings.next_verification: Verify the actual sponsor's funded payout mechanism and written acceptance process with separate official evidence; absent that, do not code for this bounty.

listings.title: Tenstorrent TTNN uint8 saturation repair bounty listed as USD 500
listings.scope: TTNN hardware kernel saturation and correctness regression on Wormhole/Blackhole devices
listings.payment_limitation: Third-party mirror remains searchable, but the original Tenstorrent issue is closed and assigned to another contributor; no payable task remains established.
listings.next_verification: Do not pursue a closed issue; select a fresh original issuer task and verify submission access first.

listings.title: Tenstorrent distributed normalization repair approved USD 3000 bounty
listings.scope: Hardware tested 2D distributed LayerNorm and RMSNorm row-stride repair
listings.payment_limitation: Original issue reports bounty approval but names an assigned contributor and requires hardware regression. Neither assignment rights nor local device verification are available.
listings.next_verification: Reject existing assignment; do not interfere with another solver or infer bounty collection from the issue amount.

listings.title: Local AI registry Intel Arc B580 recipe bounty USD 50
listings.scope: Run large-context AI inference tests on actual Intel Arc B580 hardware, submit passing recipe and benchmark
listings.payment_limitation: Original issue says sponsor arranges payment after merge by email. No verified custody or actual local availability of Intel Arc B580 GPU; six model execution checks including >15 tokens/sec required.
listings.next_verification: Confirm hardware availability and original sponsor payout policy before any attempt; otherwise reject this hardware-bound $50 task.

listings.title: Solana Pay Kit permissioned Python paid-retry error bug with no published bounty
listings.scope: Regression for Python payment transport preserving exceptions and at-most-one paid retry
listings.payment_limitation: No reward or funded assignment appears on the original issue. This is an unpaid technical problem unless the project owner separately funds work.
